name: shotcrew
description: A four-role video team that turns existing footage, product shots and screenshots into review-safe Chinese brand short videos, delivered in both 16:9 and 9:16.

profession.zh: 工业化AI短视频制片团队

displayDescription.en:
Looks shot by a real crew, not drawn from a blind box.
We fix the four fatal flaws of AI editing, plus three jobs others decline (or cannot do):
1. Review-risk guard: a built-in 117-term ad-law dictionary pins down prohibited superlative claims first, then catches unsupported bragging (e.g. "zero alcohol", "works in 3-7 days"), stopped before launch. Before touching your copy we hand you a change-proposal sheet - what to change, why, and alternatives; we only move after you approve.
2. Continuity guard: four-way locking - character look, product props, set lighting, global color grade. No face swapping within an episode, no bottle changing size, no day turning into night.
3. Trend guard: drop in a hit reference video; we extract hook-conflict-twist and rewrite your copy to that structure (structure, not sentences - your copy must be rewritten; copying is infringement).
4. Two platforms in one pass: landscape and portrait are re-composed separately, never cropped.
5. No footage needed: generative storyboard track - every shot starts as a keyframe still you approve before any video is generated (fix the direction on stills, do not burn money on video); for scripted lines, the person on screen really speaks the line - lip sync and pauses are generated in frame, not dubbed voice-over. Single-person statement pieces (talking head, product narration, quote cards, archive-style series) are the verified steady form; for multi-person scenes, large actions and cross-episode face locking we tell you upfront that we do not take them, and offer alternatives.
6. Narrative shorts (with footage): one episode, under 2 minutes, told through action and objects - a hand setting a cup down, a worn shoe sole, a jacket on an empty chair; these stick better than faces (that is how we shot our own shorts). Dialogue stays dialogue, not narration - voice, expression and action line up shot by shot, verifiable frame by frame. People appear mainly as wardrobe, hands and back views to avoid portrait-rights issues; for a face speaking to camera, use track 5 as a single-episode trial with shot-by-shot acceptance. "One face acting to camera throughout" is accepted as a single-episode trial only (no guaranteed results); no 20-episode series with one recurring lead and no cross-episode face locking; each episode is a full build, priced per episode.
7. Footage rescue: clip already generated but has garbled text, continuity breaks or mismatched blocking? Repair before re-generating - a regenerated shot costs generation credits at your account's current price (logged item by item); frame-by-frame repair costs zero. We fix what can be fixed, redo what must be redone, and quote after review.
[Straight talk]
No cinema-grade claims, nothing over 3 minutes; we do not promise virality, view counts or laughs - what we do promise: every shot verified, every line checked, every expense on the ledger.
Core promise: compliance caught early, continuity holds, brand videos delivered same day (measured 3.7-8.3 minutes per video; narrative episodes take half a day and up).
Free to install now. What we can and cannot do is agreed before we start - so you never pay for surprises.
displayDescription.zh:
像剧组拍的，不像开盲盒抽的。
专治 AI 剪片 4 个致命伤，外加 3 件别人不接（或接不了）的活：
1. 防限流：自带 117 个广告法极限词库，先钉死广告法禁用的那类极限表述，再抓「无据吹牛」（如「0 酒精」「能顶 3-7 天」），拦在上线前。改你文案之前，先给《改动建议单》——改哪句、为什么、怎么替，你点头才动笔。
2. 防穿帮：四维锁定——人物长相、产品道具、场景光影、全局色调。拒绝一集之内换一张脸、瓶子忽大忽小、窗外白天变黑夜。
3. 防落伍：丢一条爆款参考片，自动拆「钩子-冲突-反转」，照结构重写你的文案（拆的是结构，不是句子；文案必须重写，抄文案是侵权）。
4. 一次做对两个平台：横竖双画幅各自重构图，不是暴力裁切。
5. 没素材也能做：生成式分镜轨——每个镜头先出一张关键帧静图给你过目，你点头才生成视频（方向错了在图上改，不在视频上烧钱）；有台词的片子，画面里的人真的在说这句台词，口型、停顿都在画面里生成，不是配音贴上去的画外音。单人陈述式（口播、产品讲述、语录、档案系列）是验证过的稳态形态；多人对手戏、大幅动作、跨集同一张脸，开工前直接告诉你不接，给你替代方案。
6. 叙事片（有素材）：单集、2 分钟以内，用动作和物件讲故事——一只手把茶杯放下、一双鞋底磨偏、一件挂在空椅子上的外套，这些比脸更让人记住（我们自己的短剧就是这么拍的）。有台词也做：台词不压成旁白——人物在镜头里说话，声音、表情、动作三样对得上，逐镜可以指给你看。技术上人物以衣服、手、背影呈现为主，避开真人肖像权；要正脸对着镜头说话的，走第 5 条生成轨，按单集试制、逐镜验收。「一张脸对着镜头演到底」可按单集试制（不承诺稳定效果）；20 集同一主角和跨集同脸不接；每集全量制作、按集计价。
7. 救片：片子已生成但有乱码、穿帮、动作接不上？先修再谈重做——重生一镜要花生成积分（按你账号当期价，花了多少逐笔记账），逐帧修补 0 积分；能修的修、该重做的重做，看片后报价。
【坦白局】
不吹「院线级大电影」，不接 3 分钟以上长篇；不承诺上热门、不承诺播放量、不承诺内容好笑——我们能承诺的是：每个镜头都验过、每句话都对过、每笔花费都有账。
主打：合规先拦、多镜头不穿帮、品牌片当天交付（实测加工 3.7~8.3 分钟；叙事片另算，一集半天起）。
现免费上架。能做与不能做，开工前说清，不让你花冤枉钱。

defaultInitPrompt.en: I have a batch of product footage - cut me a promo short video in both landscape and portrait, with ad-law risks flagged first.
defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我有一批产品实拍素材，帮我剪一支招商短片，横版和竖版都要，广告法风险先拦一道。

quickPrompts.en: I have a batch of product footage - cut me a promo short video in both landscape and portrait, with ad-law risks flagged first.
quickPrompts.zh: 我有一批产品实拍素材，帮我剪一支招商短片，横版和竖版都要，广告法风险先拦一道。

quickPrompts.en: I have no footage - use the generative storyboard track to make a 30-second product talking-head video where the person on screen really says this line: "..." (write your line here).
quickPrompts.zh: 没有实拍素材，帮我用生成式分镜做一条 30 秒产品口播，画面里的人说出这句台词：「……」（把台词写在这里）。

quickPrompts.en: Frame-by-frame check this video for AI-generated faces, advertising law violations and burned-in subtitle typos, and give me an evidence-grade report.
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我逐帧检查这条片子：AI 生成面孔、广告法极限词、烧录字幕错字，出一份可复核的取证报告。

quickPrompts.en: Write a 45-second storyboard script for this product's brand short video, with duration and speech-rate assertions.
quickPrompts.zh: 给这款产品写一条 45 秒品牌短视频的分镜脚本，含时长与语速断言。
